Maria: Quick async — posting sprint sync for kernel + KV warmup. TL;DR: need ownership on prefetch + canary perf numbers by EOD. cc @Devon @Li @Andre
Devon: Working on the kernel prefetch handshake PR. Small refactor left, tests flaky on one worker. PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/runtime/pull/891 — running local microbench, expecting CI green by noon.
Li: Ran KV warmup canary on staging-3. Initial numbers look promising: p95 down ~12% but peak memory +10%. Raw sample: ```staging-canary: p95=28ms p99=120ms mem_rss=6.1GB``` Investigating allocation spike in warm path.
Andre: If mem regression is from the prefetch buffer we can cap the prefetch window or add soft evictions. @Tara do we want an automated rollback threshold for memory?
sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started on staging-3 (deploy/2026-03-17_09:15). Link: https://deploys.redwood/internal/2026-03-17-09-15
Maria: Ownership callout: @Devon takes the kernel prefetch PR; @Li takes KV mem investigation; @Andre owns rollout policy. @Oliver please review the perf telemetry schema change (PR referenced below).
Oliver: On review now. Heads up: telemetry schema change may affect alert parsers (alerts.yml). Adding inline comments on the PR. Also pinging @sre for runbook update.
Tara: Rollout suggestion: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m holds. Abort if p99 increases >10% or if mem_rss > 7GB on any canary host. I updated the rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollouts#prefetch
Devon: PR #891 is green. Local microbench numbers: `microbench --iters=100` => throughput +8%, p99 -9ms, tail a bit smoother. Pushing canary to staging-4 now.
Li: Found LRU-cache warm-path leak, small fix on branch `fix/lru-warm-leak`. Patch drops the mem bump to +2% on staging canary. Opening PR momentarily.
Maria: Great work. Let's collect final canary metrics at 17:00 PT and decide go/no-go. If all green we schedule dedicated-prod deploy tomorrow @ 08:00 PT. :thumbsup:
